ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 75-80% high-intensity (white) pixels vs 20-25% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity white contiguous zones covering the majority of the left and right lobes. Low-intensity black pigment is mapped to the perimeter of the trailing and leading edges, with a wide, high-contrast bifurcated central band extending from the peduncle region. Discrete low-intensity focal spots and linear streaks are distributed across the interior white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression; calculated pixel angle is approximately 70 degrees with a clear convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Maximum serration amplitude is detected at the distal tips of both lobes, with smaller, more consistent peaks and valleys toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit a convex trajectory tapering toward the tips. The trailing edges follow an irregular, generally concave trajectory from the distal tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of dark, high-contrast pixels located primarily on the extreme distal edges of both lobes, indicating localized surface irregularities.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions observed on the left lobe, including a prominent diagonal set near the central pigment band and smaller horizontal marks on the upper-left interior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavily irregular and 'ragged' topography on the distal lobe tips with dark pixel clusters suggesting permanent surface trauma or calcified growth.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique black 'V' shaped pigmentation pattern at the fluke's center that transitions into thin, vertical dark streaks on the inner white surface of the left lobe.
